fact: The Federal Ministry of Health's June 2025 NHMIS Bulletin reports national health facility data through the National Health Management Information System, with states encouraged to report directly into DHIS-2 and facilities across states and the FCT shown reporting.
The Federal Ministry of Health says the national health facility reporting rate for June 2025 was 91.5% at the time of the report, with monthly rates of 90.9% to 93.4% for January to June 2025.
